**Searching enforcement sites**

I need to look into all enforcement sites and check visibility on the server. It seems like I should be looking for at least three checks, maybe like APIV1 check for memo read access, file server attachment permission, and whether the RSS is public only. I might want to use search grep commands for `checkMemoReadAccess` and `Visibility`. There could also be some connection interceptors I need to inspect regarding the RSS.

h15.
`APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess` (used by `GetMemo` and comment reads) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`  
`APIV1Service.ListMemos` visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`  
`APIV1Service.ListMemoComments` comment visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`  
`APIV1Service.ListMemoRelations` relation visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`  
`APIV1Service.ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go`  
`APIV1Service.ListMemoReactions` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`  
`APIV1Service.checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`  
`FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`  
`RSSService.GetUserRSS` public-only query — `server/router/rss/rss.go`
